title: Shai-Hulud: install-time credential harvesting
provenance: Independently authored from Socket (2025-09-15) and StepSecurity (2025-09-15), not original package bytes. Models environment token collection, scanner invocation, and exfiltration. Scanner replaced by echo and egress by example.invalid; no token values. Baseline and versions are synthetic; the install hook exists in both versions so the comparison tests edits to existing install code. Omits worm replication, workflows, full bundle, and archive parsing.
